CustomField.description: This field captures the Approved Prepaid closed Date after 8 Feb, any case before that will be 7th Feb - using in the Dashboard Prepaid OB
CustomField.formula: IF((TEXT(Type)=='Credit Card Prepaid Application' && DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) > DATE(2023,02,7)), DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) , DATE(2023,02,6))
CustomField.label: Prepaid Approved Close Date
